// OCI provides configuration support for OCI target registries as a backend store for Flipt.
// OCIAuthentication configures the credentials for authenticating against a target OCI regitstry

package oci

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"path"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/opencontainers/go-digest"
	v1 "github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	fliptoci "go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/oci"
	storagefs "go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/storage/fs"
	"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest"
	"oras.land/oras-go/v2"
	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/content/oci"
)

func Test_SourceString(t *testing.T) {
	require.Equal(t, "oci", (&Source{}).String())
}

func Test_SourceGet(t *testing.T) {
	source, _ := testSource(t)

	snap, err := source.Get(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)

	_, err = snap.GetNamespace(context.TODO(), "production")
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func Test_SourceSubscribe(t *testing.T) {
	source, target := testSource(t)

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())

	// prime source
	_, err := source.Get(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// start subscription
	ch := make(chan *storagefs.StoreSnapshot)
	go source.Subscribe(ctx, ch)

	updateRepoContents(t, target,
		layer(
			"production",
			`{"namespace":"production","flags":[{"key":"foo","name":"Foo"}]}`,
			fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptNamespace,
		),
	)

	t.Log("waiting for new snapshot")

	// assert matching state
	var snap *storagefs.StoreSnapshot

selection.summary: OCI storage backend config gaps fixed. Evidence shows: internal/config/storage.go already validates OCI config (repository required; registry.ParseReference errors wrapped as "validating OCI configuration: %w") and already had bundles_directory/authentication tags, so the code change adds a PollInterval (mapstructure/yaml "poll_interval") field to the OCI struct. The OCI sections of config/flipt.schema.cue and config/flipt.schema.json lacked bundles_directory and poll_interval; both schemas were updated to accept them. Verified against config_test.go OCI cases (provided/invalid no repo/invalid unexpected repo), the OCI source's WithPollInterval option (default 30s), and analogous git/local/s3 poll_interval patterns.

native_export.selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles plus at most one presented, provenance-valid adjacent test read for a selected same-stem implementation source; native source projection and export unchanged.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
